query: SELECT s.tenant_id, s.id FROM sources AS s WHERE s.content IS NULL AND s.content_nulled_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $2) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observation_links AS l WHERE l.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND l.source_id = s.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM generation_operation_sources AS g WHERE g.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND g.source_id = s.id) ORDER BY s.content_nulled_at LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED
